name: Law-practice matter files
one_line: A gist-level professional placeholder for one practitioner-side representation or matter: the engagement record, client communications, filings, docket notices, discovery, evidence, internal work product, calendars, billing, and transfer or closure packet. It recognizes the representation workflow and protects the packet without turning a client, party, matter, case number, practice area, date, document kind, or legal conclusion into a Legal fact or folder level.

deterministic: a signed engagement or representation record whose labelled addressee and counsel blocks distinguish a client from a legal practitioner or firm, whose own heading and scope section describe legal services for one matter, and whose fee and signature sections complete the practitioner-client workflow. A law-firm name, a fee clause, the word engagement, or two signatures separately establish nothing

a client-and-matter assessment whose own labelled slots identify a prospective or current client, a matter description or identifier, a responsible practitioner, a conflict or risk review, and a recorded review action. This is evidence of a professional intake workflow; any compliance-risk label remains raw source evidence and never becomes this product’s sensitivity classification

a court filing carrying a tribunal caption, case or docket identifier, filing kind, filed stamp or electronic document identifier, and a counsel block that explicitly names the holder or holder’s firm as representative. A public pleading downloaded for reading has the same caption and filing structure, so the representation link is required for this template

an electronic-filing notice in labelled email slots whose sender is a court system, whose subject or body names a case and docket event, and whose body records the filed item plus a document or docket link sent to the holder’s practitioner account. The link is evidence only and is never followed automatically

a saved docket sheet whose table carries one case identifier and repeated dated event rows, joined to the practitioner-side packet by an exact filed-document identifier, notice identifier, or explicit representation record. A docket sheet standing alone is a court record, not proof that it is the holder’s matter

a discovery, deposition, exhibit, or expert-report artifact whose own caption and labelled record structure identify a proceeding and whose exact case or matter identifier matches an independently evidenced practitioner-side anchor. The match supports reviewable packet membership; it copies no client, party, issue, or legal conclusion onto the artifact

an internal memorandum or work note whose own header labels a client or matter reference and whose sections distinguish facts supplied, issues, research, analysis, tasks, or strategy, together with a producer marker for the holder’s practitioner team. The structure supports this workflow but does not establish privilege, work-product protection, correctness, or legal effect

a client or counsel email whose labelled sender and recipient roles cross the practitioner-client or counsel boundary, whose subject carries an exact matter reference, and whose attachments or body name a concrete filing, request, advice record, or transaction document. Addresses and message content remain local; a thread, subject token, or attachment name alone is insufficient

a matter time or billing workbook whose labelled sheets and columns pair one exact matter identifier with timekeeper, task, duration, expense, rate, or invoice roles and whose issuer and billed-to blocks distinguish the practitioner from the client. The accounting structure activates Finance on its own evidence; it supports this template only through the separately evidenced representation workflow

a calendar event whose labelled summary, organizer, attendee, location, and identifier slots tie a hearing, deposition, signing, closing, or client meeting to one exact case or matter reference already supported by the event itself. Calendar source type, a date, or a legal-sounding summary alone never fires

a matter-system export whose manifest, read without unpacking, includes an export index and several coherent professional families such as engagement, correspondence, pleadings, discovery, evidence, research, billing, and closure, all tied by one explicit matter identifier. Directory names are observations and do not become facts on members
needs_llm: whether a court filing, agreement, or correspondence packet is the practitioner holder’s client matter or the holder’s own personal legal record. The same bytes can appear on either side; a local model may interpret explicit role language, but a firm name, party name, or current folder never resolves the holder’s role

whether a two-organization engagement letter or statement of work is a legal representation for this template or a consulting engagement for career.consulting-client-engagement. Scope, fees, confidentiality, deliverables, and signatures occur on both; explicit counsel, representation, legal-services, tribunal, or legal-work-product structure must carry the legal side

whether a public opinion, pleading, statute, article, or precedent copy is active matter research or merely saved reading. An exact citation from an independently anchored matter note or an explicit matter-system reference may support membership; topic similarity and citation vocabulary do not

whether sparse notes, a calendar item, an attachment, or a time entry belongs to a matter whose rich anchors live elsewhere. The outcome may be context-supported membership for review; it never writes the anchor’s client, matter, party, or case identifier as a fact on the sparse file

whether an OCR capture is an e-filing receipt, client portal, evidence image, public court page, or unrelated screenshot. Positive screen-origin evidence activates Photos independently and never weakens Legal protection

whether a mixed matter export contains files governed by different access restrictions or different clients. The model may propose a local review boundary from manifest evidence but may not infer privilege, confidentiality, sealing, waiver, or authorization and may never use semantic similarity to bridge matters

whether a billing record is merely a Finance file that references a client or also belongs in the accepted professional matter packet. The invoice or time sheet keeps its Finance facts; matter membership depends on an exact identifier or explicit reference and copies nothing

whether two drafts, redlines, signed copies, filed copies, and court-stamped copies form one version or derivation family. Similar names and dates are insufficient; exact hashes, explicit revision markers, filing identifiers, or user confirmation must support the relationship

whether an unfamiliar, multilingual, or jurisdiction-specific professional artifact belongs to a representation workflow when no approved pattern covers its labels. The route is local interpretation or abstention; this gist-level placeholder defines no jurisdiction catalogue and no legal rule
never_alone: the words lawyer, attorney, solicitor, counsel, legal, matter, case, client, privileged, confidential, work product, advice, claim, dispute, contract, filing, discovery, or evidence. Public material, personal records, consulting work, invoices, policies, training, and software all use the same vocabulary

a law-firm, practitioner, client, adverse-party, court, regulator, expert, or witness name by itself. Letterheads, citations, public filings, directories, biographies, and correspondence can carry the same name in different roles

a case number, docket number, matter number, invoice number, exhibit label, document number, or Bates-shaped token. An identifier supplies linkage only after its own labelled role and anchor are established; digits never establish a date

a court caption, filed stamp, legal citation, pleading title, or published opinion by itself. Public court material and saved research have the same observations and may have no representation relationship to the holder
a source type or extension alone, including text_document, email, archive, spreadsheet, calendar, image, ocr, audio_video, PDF, DOCX, EML, MSG, ZIP, XLSX, CSV, ICS, PNG, JPG, MP4, or HTML

a filename or folder containing a client name, matter, case, legal, litigation, closing, confidential, final, signed, filed, or privileged. Paths stay local, existing folders support review only, and neither may activate Legal or write a fact
author, creator, producer, or last-saved-by metadata naming a practitioner or firm. Document templates, scanners, court systems, prior editors, and outside counsel can write those slots

membership in one email thread, download session, calendar series, transfer batch, archive, current directory, or shared workspace. These relationships retrieve candidates but do not prove topic, representation, or member facts

a date, deadline-shaped phrase, hearing time, calendar alarm, or four-digit number. The product neither calculates legal deadlines nor interprets a date as operative, satisfied, missed, or jurisdictionally valid
public availability, a public docket, a published filing, or a public court opinion as proof that the local copy or its surrounding matter context is low sensitivity or eligible for a cloud prompt

a confidential, privileged, attorney-client, work-product, sealed, restricted, or subject-to-protective-order label. The product preserves the literal observation and does not decide legal status, scope, waiver, access, or disclosure rights

the absence of EXIF, mobile dimensions, PNG format, dense OCR, or a browser-like layout as proof of an e-filing screenshot. Positive screen-origin evidence belongs to Photos and the content still needs its own anchor

a transcript-shaped dialogue, expert opinion, medical record, client identity document, or personal-data table merely because it sits inside a matter packet. Its own schema evidence and protection remain independent, and the group copies no label

matching party names, subject matter, citations, or semantic similarity across two matters. Cross-matter retrieval is suppressed unless an exact explicit reference or user decision authorizes the relationship
file count, archive size, split-part numbering, a familiar export layout, or a long time span as proof that a bundle is one matter or safe to inspect
an encrypted, password-protected, malformed, unsupported, or inaccessible file whose only professional clue is its name. It is not forced open and gains no client or matter purpose from metadata

grouping_reasons: one explicitly opened representation or matter, anchored by a signed engagement or intake record and an exact matter identifier. The anchor supports a candidate packet; it does not create client, matter, party, or document facts on members

one filed-document family: draft, signed version, exhibits, filed copy, court-stamped copy, docket entry, and electronic-filing notice linked by an exact document or filing identifier rather than similar names

one discovery or production set whose request, response, production index, native archive, and exhibit references carry one explicit production identifier. The archive stays intact and manifests are inspected without unpacking
one deposition, hearing, witness, or expert package linked by an exact proceeding, transcript, recording, or exhibit identifier. A shared person name and date never establish the package

one transaction or closing packet whose index names exact instruments, signatures, checklists, deliveries, and completion records. Purpose coherence is a reviewable membership decision and creates no Legal purpose fact

one matter export whose index, manifest, and member paths use one explicit export and matter identifier. The export remains a shallow protected packet unless the user approves a different representation

a sparse note, calendar event, email, invoice, or attachment may join a bounded matter neighborhood when an anchor names its exact identifier or path. Membership may exist while the sparse file retains only universal or independently activated schema facts
no ordinary group is also valid: one engagement letter, filing notice, strategy note, or expert report may remain a protected record when no reliable matter packet forms

template.why: Empty by binding contract, J-IND scope, and privacy. Legal is a D1 and PR-6 fieldless safety placeholder, so this template cannot branch on client, firm, party, counterparty, counsel, matter, case identifier, practice area, jurisdiction, stage, date, tribunal, or document kind; none is a Legal field. J-IND authorizes gist-level professional recognition now and defers full industry depth, so this row does not recreate practice areas, litigation phases, transaction types, or the dozens of sibling schemas from the overnight catalogue. A visible client or matter label can itself disclose the existence and subject of a representation. The present recommendation is therefore one shallow, redacted, user-approved matter packet or representation without automatic internal depth. If Legal fields are later ratified, the organizing anchor would ordinarily precede document function and time, but that remains prose rather than a serialized dimension. This is not time-first: filing time, event time, document date, receipt time, and filesystem creation time have different meanings, and year-first branching would scatter one representation. Any later branch requires explicit user review under the privacy policy and the frozen destination tree.

collides_with.signal: The same summons, order, agreement, correspondence, and court download can sit in a practitioner’s client file or in an individual’s own records. The discriminator is the holder’s evidenced role and workflow: a signed engagement or representation record, practitioner-side client and matter assessment, firm matter-system identifier, counsel work product, or filing notice delivered to the holder’s practitioner account supports this row; the holder named as a party with no practitioner-side anchor supports personal legal matters. A court caption, party name, legal term, or current folder decides neither.

Both situations produce engagement letters, statements of work, client correspondence, deliverables, invoices, confidentiality language, and two-organization signature blocks. Explicit counsel or representation roles, a legal-services scope, tribunal or docket structure, legal-practice matter-system provenance, or internal legal research and strategy supports this row; a prepared-for and prepared-by consulting pair with scope, milestones, deliverables, and acceptance structure supports the consulting engagement. Client name, fee language, confidentiality clauses, and signatures decide neither.

A practitioner’s time sheet, invoice, expense report, matter budget, and client ledger are both matter-workflow members and Finance-shaped operational records. The discriminator for the evidence item is structural: labelled issuer, billed-to, invoice, payment, line-item, time, rate, expense, or reconciliation slots support bookkeeping; a representation anchor, filing, discovery artifact, client instruction, or legal work-product structure supports the professional matter. An exact matter reference may support packet membership but never converts the financial record into a Legal fact, and a client name or amount counts for neither side.

falls_through_to.why: The primary home for a recognized engagement record, filing, work note, transcript, client correspondence, identity copy, or matter packet when no accepted professional group or approved branch exists. 00: "Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts."

The cautious outcome for a readable professional-looking document whose practitioner role, active representation, or neighboring workflow remains unresolved, including a consulting-style statement of work with no legal anchor. 00: "Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision."

The safe outcome for a password-protected matter archive, inaccessible practice database, malformed production, or unknown binary. The filename never supplies a client or matter purpose. 00: "Unsupported or Encrypted may hold—or, more safely, represent without moving—password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats."

The inactive home for a public opinion, legal article, practice guide, report, or precedent copy with no explicit client, matter, research project, or accepted professional relationship. 00: "Reading Inbox may hold papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association."

The inactive fallback for a positively evidenced screen capture whose OCR does not establish a practitioner-side matter or another accepted workflow. Account names, identifiers, and links remain redacted. 00: "Temporary Screenshots may live under Photos/Temporary Screenshots and hold screenshots that appear time-sensitive or remind the user of something but have no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship."

sensitivity_why: A professional matter packet can combine another person’s or organization’s instructions, identity records, communications, financial information, medical records, allegations, witness material, discovery, expert work, strategy, legal research, credentials, access links, settlement positions, and billing across a long representation. Client-confidential is the catalogue default for this situation, but the product does not infer privilege, work-product protection, sealing, waiver, disclosure rights, or any jurisdictional legal status. Legal protection and P7 classification precede every model and placement path. Paths, filenames, matter identifiers, client and party names, firm names, addresses, correspondence, complete text, OCR, transcripts, docket history, manifests, member paths, hashes, links, access tokens, group memberships, financial values, images, audio, and raw evidence remain local. Public availability of one filing does not make the local matter context safe to disclose. Shared UI redacts names, previews, excerpts, thumbnails, docket entries, and member lists under user policy. This row assigns only potentially_sensitive and does not assign, alias, rank, or infer a P7 handling class.
open_question: Four decisions remain outside this gist-level row. First, D1 and PR-6 leave Legal with no fields: if that changes, Joseph must decide whether a matter identifier, client, holder firm, party, counterparty, counsel role, practice area, tribunal, phase, document kind, or operative date may be stored at all. This row proposes none. The canonical client and our_firm pair describes an engagement role but is not referenced by Legal; project and artifact_type are Research and Code fields, institution and record_type are Finance fields, purpose remains College-applications-scoped, and jurisdiction is never a field or dimension. Second, Joseph must decide whether a client-named or matter-named physical branch is acceptable, since its label discloses a representation even when its contents are protected; today the recommendation is a shallow redacted packet with no automatic depth. Third, R1c and P9 must decide how an exact matter, filing, production, transcript, or manifest reference records membership without copying client, case, party, or subject labels onto members, and how cross-matter retrieval barriers are represented. Fourth, P7 and the user policy must own the distinction among public court material, client-confidential information, privilege, work product, sealing, protective orders, and disclosure consent. This catalogue records literal observations and abstains; it must not convert any of those legal statuses into its own vocabulary.
